svg.title: Staggered silicon–tungsten ECAL: tested four-layer prototype
svg.desc: True barrel module masks and four endcap packing families, plus a scaled layer cutaway. Internal module gaps shift by half the 96 mm pitch; full-depth sector seams remain.
svg.text: Tested physical prototype • 48 sampling layers • four-layer module pattern repeated 12 times
Front views of the same central patch; u is tangential, z is along the beam.
Same 574 mm PCB span: 6 full boards → 5 full + 2 narrow edge boards.
White channels are inactive module gaps; the four masks do not have aligned gaps.
u–depth cut at z = 24 mm; depth is enlarged ×5 relative to u.
example track at a module gap
The track crosses active Si in L2/L4 instead of staying in a module gap.
PCB shown; skins, guards, ASICs, cooling and films simplified in this cut.
C | Full and narrow edge modules
2 mm PCB margin + 1 mm Si guard per edge; 2 mm between PCBs.
Active-to-active gap: 8 mm. Readout: four / two ASICs (not drawn).
Short end slabs: 24 mm axial shift; full slabs: 48 mm away from the bay.
D | Endcap: four physical wedge families
Actual packed masks, one of sixteen 22.5° sectors. Half-pitch offsets are tangential / radial.
Internal module gaps are staggered. The sixteen full-depth sector seams and service reservations remain.
Also retained: ±96 mm mechanical slab staggering, absorber planes, carrier envelopes and cooling.
Geometry: PR136/137 tested prototype • DES-030 / DES-031 • source 3ebafd340b0e • plan views to scale; supports omitted.
